name: Post-Process Noise Clamping & Exponentiation
definition: A two-step texture preprocessing function applied to generated noise data to shrink its dynamic range and control edge hardness, producing cloud-like alpha distributions suitable for volume rendering.
summary: Post-Process Noise Clamping & Exponentiation is a deterministic texture preprocessing technique that shrinks noise dynamic range and controls edge hardness by modifying final amplitude values rather than altering generation algorithms.
